job.purpose: S81 gather (dsfd_sp_gather_c, 2.9 M flops flat, does not fit its slot): hardened 4-root leaf of the gather cluster (W half: lanes enter W, leave E). Each root = ot_s81ph_ret_root_s (step B, S = 8 open rows = 2 x the measured real bound 4; S = 16 does not fit the slot: g1 stopped at FLOORPLAN_MARGIN, util 0.716): input queue in a 128 x 66 1R1W array, CAM-free pairing store {open-row slot, parent node} in a 256 x 34 array; cycle-identical to ot_s81ph_ret_root_p inside both capacities, sticky fault on a 9th open row. REAL field order (production binding d9f84be9, all 40 layers, golden experts): at most 4 (row, pos) open per root. Every port a flop at the pin; lanes passed on registered; column chain registered.

floorplan_why: 190.08 x 164.16: the slot (1727.976 x 803.496) gives 8 columns x 4 rows of leaves: column pitch 216 at most, row pitch 185.5, so a leaf is <= 194.4 x 164.16. 8 arrays of 28..30-um height cannot each keep 20-um channels in that box, so the four pairing arrays (256 x 34: 38.664 x 28.92) and the four queue arrays (128 x 66: 37.368 x 28.104) are two ABUTTED N-S stacks (pins on W / E only; pitch 28.944 / 28.128 = array height + 0.024 so every array stays on the M4 track grid): pairing stack at x 22.5, queue stack at x 130.5, root g at level g of both, its logic in the 69-um band between them. 20-um channels round both stacks. Std ~8.4k um2 (the g1 route synthesized 9,899 um2 at S 16) + arrays 8.7k um2 in 29.7k um2 of core = 0.575. Lanes W -> E: 276 b end here, 828 b cross both stacks through the N / S channels (~2.1k M2 + M4 tracks: 0.51 at the first stack); chain N -> S 636 -> 848 b along the band (M3 / M5).
